$comment: The committed base lock. Everything the generation environment is built from is fixed here,
in source, before anything runs. The build consumes these values and is not allowed to resolve
its own: pulling a mutable tag would let the base image change under a green gate.
The machine-specific image id is NOT here. It is a build artifact, written to
benchmarks/v2/runs/image-build.json, because it is produced by running the benchmark rather
than by editing it. Changing this file changes HEAD, which invalidates both gates by design.

baseProvenance.note: Multi-architecture manifest list. node:22-bookworm-slim@<digest> resolves to this exact list on every host.
